title: Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) Given “Buy” Rating at Rosenblatt Securities
text:
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) Given “Buy” Rating at Rosenblatt Securities Posted by Paula Ricardo | Jun 20th, 2018
Rosenblatt Securities restated their buy rating on shares of Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) in a report released on Tuesday, June 5th. Rosenblatt Securities currently has a $80.00 price target on the technology company’s stock.
“We believe the selloff was an overreaction to the news and believe that Lumentum remains the best positioned name in the 3D sensing space. We believe that 3D sensing momentum is likely to occur throughout the balance of this year and should allow Apple (AAPL: Buy) to create new applications and improve performance in its new iPhones and iPad Pros. We view this as a cata- lyst for Lumentum. We reiterate our buy rating and $80 price target. Lumentum’s telecom business should start to see some ramping from ROADM in China in 3Q18. We believe this will help the company’s China business re- gain momentum and return the segment to sequential growth. We believe the company’s CWDM4 shipments to Amazon (AMZN: NR) should ramp sequen- tially in the third quarter, driving new growth in the telecom business. U.S.”,” the firm’s analyst wrote. A number of other brokerages have also weighed in on LITE. BidaskClub raised shares of Lumentum from a buy rating to a strong-buy rating in a report on Wednesday, March 14th. Stifel Nicolaus reissued a buy rating and issued a $79.00 price target on shares of Lumentum in a report on Thursday, March 15th. Craig Hallum set a $90.00 price target on shares of Lumentum and gave the company a buy rating in a report on Tuesday, March 13th. MKM Partners raised their price target on shares of Lumentum to $88.00 and gave the company a buy rating in a report on Wednesday, March 14th. Finally, Drexel Hamilton reissued a buy rating and issued a $85.00 price target on shares of Lumentum in a report on Wednesday, March 21st. Four analysts have rated the stock with a hold rating and fourteen have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company has a consensus rating of Buy and an average target price of $81.53.
Lumentum opened at $55.65 on Tuesday, according to Marketbeat . The company has a market cap of $3.57 billion, a PE ratio of 35.00, a PEG ratio of 1.06 and a beta of 0.06. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.38, a current ratio of 5.56 and a quick ratio of 4.81. Lumentum has a 1-year low of $41.95 and a 1-year high of $74.40.
Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Wednesday, May 2nd. The technology company reported $0.78 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $0.71 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $299.00 million during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $292.30 million. Lumentum had a net margin of 13.63% and a return on equity of 23.35%. The company’s revenue was up 16.8% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $0.49 earnings per share. equities analysts predict that Lumentum will post 2.9 earnings per share for the current year.
In other news, COO Vincent Retort sold 1,156 shares of Lumentum stock in a transaction on Wednesday, May 16th. The shares were sold at an average price of $63.59, for a total transaction of $73,510.04. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this link . Also, CEO Alan S. Lowe sold 11,672 shares of Lumentum stock in a transaction on Monday, May 21st. The stock was sold at an average price of $63.02, for a total transaction of $735,569.44. Following the transaction, the chief executive officer now directly owns 208,062 shares in the company, valued at $13,112,067.24. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 29,440 shares of company stock valued at $1,863,478 in the last ninety days. Company insiders own 0.76% of the company’s stock.

About Lumentum
Lumentum Holdings Inc manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Optical Communications and Commercial Lasers. The Optical Communications segment offers components, modules, and subsystems that enable the transmission and transport of video, audio, and text data over high-capacity fiber optic cables.
